verdict.rationale: Several SKILL.md files state what the skill does and, in some cases, when it should be used: understand-project runs 'before planning or implementing a requested change', and the Ralph loop handles 'exactly one explicitly assigned' task. The validator also checks 'invocation contracts', which suggests each skill carries a defined activation contract. However, only three of the eight skills are evidenced, and activation triggers are explicit for only some of them. Missing for 10: evidence that every skill documents both purpose and activation conditions, explicit activation triggers for ledger-tasks/wiki/planning/benchmark/artifact skills, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, every skill documents what it does and when it activates, so I can predict my agent's new behavior before it surprises me

citations.quote: Inspect the current product architecture, dependencies, and validation loops before planning or implementing a requested change.
Execute exactly one explicitly assigned YYLO Ledger task through the Ralph loop to a validated queued commit.
Retrieve any YYLO Ledger Record by ID, discover PDRs and artifacts, and manage tasks and dependencies.
It checks nested references for retired lifecycle instructions as well as invocation contracts and plugin version parity.
